The Tragedian is a member of the crew who is tasked with acting out an assigned "theme" throughout the round. This theme can be a variety of abstract concepts like "revenge" or "betrayal."
The success of this objective is determined by the stagehands. To help with this, the Tragedian has two abilities: - They will always hear stagehands cheer and boo - They have an action which allows them to call over all stagehands to view them
In order to succeed at their objective, the Tragedian must first perish. Unlike most other masks with this goal, they don't need to be killed. Simply dying in any way is enough to fulfill this.
Upon death, a vote will be given to all stagehands, asking them if they thought the Tragedian embodied their theme. If the vote passes with a majority saying "yes," the objective will count as completed.
